title: Minimum Cost Walk in Weighted Graph
goal: Answer minimum bitwise-AND walk costs between queried vertices.
strategy: Repeated-edge walks can detour through every edge in a connected component. AND never increases when another weight is included, so the minimum cost is the AND of all component edge weights; disconnected endpoints return minus one.
